chapter: After Basie: freelancing, JATP and Hollywood
title: Basie's small group and its reception
summary: Basie formed a small group, kept only Clark Terry, and drew static from audiences.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Was that kind of a surprise to you that he ended up with a group of people…well, Clark Terry was in it, but I guess he was the only one…
Yeah, nobody didn’t know. He was the only one. Freddie Green didn’t go…

Buddy DeFranco and Serge Chaloff. Well, Gus Johnson had been in the band before, in the old Basie band in Kansas City. But he had a bunch of guys that weren’t affiliated with Count Basie so far as the public was concerned at all. And he did get a lot of static at places that he played. Not that the guys that he had playing with him weren’t capable but they were just so used to seeing certain faces up there, like Buddy Tate…
Did you have any insight as to how he ended up choosing that or how it was put together for him?
No, I don’t have any idea.
